heldout_rule: held-out seeds (>= 101) and the held-out vocabulary were never generated before this freeze; they are run once on the frozen engine and reported as they come out
blind_rule: the ST7757 run happens after this freeze and is frozen before any external (freelancer / MCP) record is opened; development read the drawing only, never an external quantity
known_context: the M1-M5 history of this repository (including the M5 reconciliation findings) was known while the detectors were written; the detectors are generic (no project mark, coordinate, layer list or quantity) and are validated on held-out synthetic villas
